```{=html}
<!-- Google Custom Search Engine -->
<script async src="https://cse.google.com/cse.js?cx=815456853205e4214"></script>

<style>
.search-wrapper {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 30px auto;
  padding: 0 16px;
}
.gsc-control-cse {
  font-family: inherit !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}
.gsc-input-box {
  border-radius: 6px !important;
}
.gsc-search-button-v2 {
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  background-color: #238A8D !important;
  border-color: #238A8D !important;
}
</style>

<div class="search-wrapper">
  <div class="gcse-search"></div>
</div>

<script>
// If ?q= is in the URL, wait for GCSE to render then auto-submit the search
(function () {
  var q = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('q');
  if (!q) return;

  var attempts = 0;
  var iv = setInterval(function () {
    var input = document.querySelector('input.gsc-input');
    var btn   = document.querySelector('button.gsc-search-button');
    if (input && btn) {
      input.value = q;
      btn.click();
      clearInterval(iv);
    }
    if (++attempts > 50) clearInterval(iv); // give up after 5s
  }, 100);
})();
</script>
```
